title: Groundwork for the Booking page: Calendly links made for a person (switched off)
text: The hidden engine of the future Booking page is in, and it is switched off, so nothing changes today. Later you will make a Calendly link for a chosen person (lead, client, partner or private), and when they book through it the system will know who it was for: a client's call will be saved under the client instead of creating a stray lead, a wrong email or a used link will fall back to what happens today and leave a card for a person to check. Already part of this release and visible once such calls exist: the contact page can list "Booked calls", and the Zoom recordings sorter knows about calls booked this way, so a client call is not filed as a marketing call.
